SERVER_KEY.description: Random secret that signs connector device tokens and seals the Feishu credentials and model key at rest. Generate one now: `openssl rand -hex 32` (keep a copy; see [rotating it](docs/deploy.md#secrets-and-rotation)).

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Random one-time password that unlocks the setup page after deploy. Generate a **different** random string: `openssl rand -hex 32`. You will need it as `?token=…` to open `https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/setup`.

MODEL_KEY.description: Your model provider's API key (default provider: DeepSeek — get one at [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com)). Stored encrypted in your own Cloudflare account. You can leave this empty for now and set it later with `wrangler secret put MODEL_KEY`.
